velkomst.p1: Come and try an exciting activity for you and your friends – one of the coolest experiences in West Jutland! Two teams go head-to-head equipped with laser guns and vests in an older building with character, where only the strongest team survives.
velkomst.p2: If you're looking for fun activities near Blåvand, this is the perfect experience for friends, family and colleagues. The center is located at Mønstervej 60, 6854 Henne and is set up as a dark, two-storey labyrinth filled with hiding spots and surprises.
velkomst.p3: Max. 10 players at a time divided into two teams. If you are more, we will set up a tournament – and only one team can claim the glory.

regler.title: RULES OF THE GAME
regler.p1: Two teams fight from their own base through a winding labyrinth across two floors in two connected buildings.
regler.p2: You score points by hitting opponents – but if you get hit yourself, you lose points.
regler.p3: When you're hit, your vest makes noise for 10 seconds and your weapon stops working. Retreat to your base and come back ready to fight.
regler.p4: After the battle, both a team score and individual rankings are shown, so everyone knows who carried the team – and who didn't.
regler.p5: Do YOU have what it takes to become West Jutland's best laser warrior?
regler.p6: Due to the size of the vest and the ability to understand the game, a participant age of 6 years and up is normally recommended.

slides.title: Birthday Party
slides.text:
Make the birthday extra exciting with lasergame! One of the most fun experiences on the west coast! Lively like a video game in an environment of light, smoke, and sound effects, a bit like Counter-Strike in real life.
At children's birthday parties, the birthday child plays for free when minimum requirements are met, creating a special experience and a day the children will remember for a long time.
This requires a minimum booking of two games for at least 6 people! Free birthday child requires min. 8 people

slides.alt: Two women walking towards each other in lasergame gear
slides.title: Team Building
slides.text:
Is your company located near Oksbøl, Esbjerg, Varde, or Blåvand? Or are you coming from far away?
No matter where you come from, this is an ideal activity for companies, associations or groups.
Through intense lasergame experiences, relationships and community are strengthened in a fun and different way.

slides.alt: Woman and group of friends playing lasergame together
slides.title: Parties and private events
slides.text:
Whether it's a group of friends, a family event or another celebration, the center can be booked outside of peak season.
This provides an opportunity for a different and active experience where everyone can join in.

slides.alt: People in lasergame gear waiting for the game to start
slides.title: Mobile lasergame – we come to you
slides.text:
Not on the west coast? Fear not! We come to you!
With the mobile solution from OX-Consult, lasergame can be brought to your own location.
Perfect for schools, events or companies looking for a flexible solution.

slides.title: Flexible facilities
slides.text:
If you have a hall or a larger space, it can easily be transformed into a lasergame arena using tables, boxes or gym equipment.
This creates a unique and customised experience in your own setting.
